page_title: NAN 0-2 LIL | Nantes v Lille 19/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' None of the Nantes players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
90+4' Nantes have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+1' Bruno Genesio has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Andre Gomes (Lille) replacing Hakon Arnar Haraldsson.
90+1' Substitution. Mathias Fernandez-Pardo leaves the pitch and is replaced by Ethan Mbappe (Lille).
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
89' 0 - 2 Hamza Igamane (Lille) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Anthony Lopes with a strike into the bottom left corner. He makes it 0:2.
87' Chidozie Awaziem (Nantes) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.
85' Excellent touch by Hamza Igamane (Lille)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box and produces a shot goalwards which goes way wide of the left post.
83' Here's the change. Hyeok-Kyu Kwon leaves the pitch and Uros Radakovic (Nantes) comes on as a substitute.
83' Yassine Benhattab (Nantes) will take the corner.

83' Hyeok-Kyu Kwon (Nantes) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort. Nantes win a corner.
82' Substitution. Felix Correia makes his way off the pitch and Osame Sahraoui (Lille) comes on as his replacement.
82' Here is a change. Romain Perraud is going off and Bruno Genesio gives the last tactical orders to Calvin Verdonk (Lille).
81' Romain Perraud (Lille) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
76' Olivier Giroud goes off the pitch and Hamza Igamane (Lille) comes on.
76' A pass across the box picks out an unmarked Olivier Giroud (Lille) and he tries to place the ball towards the roof of the net, but it goes just over the bar.
74' Yellow card. Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
72' Having seen unsporting behavior, Thomas Leonard shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Bruno Genesio (Lille) is the recipient.

71' Anthony Lopes pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the right post, but was stopped by the goalkeeper.
71' Lille can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
69' Dehmaine Tabibou comes off the pitch to be replaced by Bahmed Deuff (Nantes).
67' The referee cannot ignore such behaviour. Benjamin Andre (Lille) sees a yellow card and needs to watch himself for the rest of the game.
66' Louis Leroux (Nantes) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
66' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) commits a rough challenge and Thomas Leonard blows his whistle for an infringement.
63' Luis Castro prepares a substitution. Bahereba Guirassy is replaced by Yassine Benhattab (Nantes).
63' Mostafa Mohamed will be replaced by Youssef El Arabi (Nantes).
63' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 7:7.
60' A corner kick by Lille is thwarted by the well prepared Anthony Lopes (Nantes).
58' A pass by Benjamin Andre (Lille) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
57' Romain Perraud (Lille) neatly controls a driven pass on the edge of the box, glances up and cracks a beautiful drive goalwards that sails just over the bar.
55' Lille take a short corner kick.
55' Lille enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
54' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Nantes.
53' The Nantes players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
50' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Thomas Leonard stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.

47' That was a nice football moment. Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the bottom right corner. Anthony Lopes guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!
46' Dehmaine Tabibou (Nantes) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
46' Referee Thomas Leonard blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+3' Junior Mwanga (Nantes) commits a foul and Thomas Leonard immediately signals a free kick.

45+2' A neat pass finds Matthis Abline (Nantes) in space. He needs no second invitation to shoot and hits a piledriver from distance low towards the middle of the goal, but Berke Ozer denies him with a good save.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Matthis Abline (Nantes) receives a pass on the edge of the box and attempts a lob as the keeper is off his line, but the effort crashes off the crossbar.
43' Referee Thomas Leonard has finally had enough of Luis Castro and brandishes a yellow card at him!
42' Lille fail to score from a corner as Anthony Lopes (Nantes) leaps to collect the ball.
39' Felix Correia (Lille) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play.
39' Thomas Meunier (Lille) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
37' Nantes fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
36' Thomas Leonard blows his whistle as Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
36' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top.
34' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Tylel Tati (Nantes).
32' A loose pass is instantly latched onto by Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille). He tries his luck from the edge of the box with a measured shot, but it hits the right post and is cleared to safety.
32' The statistic for corner kicks – 0:4.
32' The Nantes players are exchanging some short passes.
28' Aissa Mandi (Lille) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
25' Aissa Mandi (Lille) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
24' Lille failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
24' Referee Thomas Leonard signals NO PENALTY for Nantes after a VAR review!
23' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Nantes! Let's see what he decides.
21' Thomas Leonard shows a yellow card to Thomas Meunier (Lille) for his blatant foul.
19' Matthis Abline (Nantes) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Berke Ozer is alert and denies him with a nice save.
17' Benjamin Andre (Lille) latches on to a sweet cross inside the box and misses with a header high above the bar.
16' A cross from a corner kick by Lille is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
14' The resulting set piece from Lille is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
12' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lille comes to nothing.
12' The Lille players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
11' Romain Perraud (Lille) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
9' Benjamin Andre (Lille) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
8' 0 - 1 Fantastic team goal! Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) was set free in the area by Olivier Giroud and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
7' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
6' Romain Perraud (Lille) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.

5' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
4' The ball is cleared after Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
3' Tylel Tati (Nantes) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
2' Great teamplay by Lille as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
1' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.

Lille will kick the game off.
